entries.title: Psalms 22:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. Set to "The Deer of the Dawn." A Psalm of David.>> My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me? [Why are You so] far from helping Me, [And from] the words of My groaning?

entries.title: Psalms 22:2
segments: O My God, I cry in the daytime, but You do not hear; And in the night season, and am not silent.

entries.title: Psalms 22:3
segments: But You [are] holy, Enthroned in the praises of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 22:4
segments: Our fathers trusted in You; They trusted, and You delivered them.

entries.title: Psalms 22:5
segments: They cried to You, and were delivered; They trusted in You, and were not ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 22:6
segments: But I [am] a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised by the people.

entries.title: Psalms 22:7
segments: All those who see Me ridicule Me; They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, [saying],

entries.title: Psalms 22:8
segments: "He trusted in the LORD, let Him rescue Him; Let Him deliver Him, since He delights in Him!"

entries.title: Psalms 22:9
segments: But You [are] He who took Me out of the womb; You made Me trust [while] on My mother's breasts.

entries.title: Psalms 22:10
segments: I was cast upon You from birth. From My mother's womb You [have been] My God.

entries.title: Psalms 22:11
segments: ¶Be not far from Me, For trouble [is] near; For [there is] none to help.

entries.title: Psalms 22:12
segments: Many bulls have surrounded Me; Strong [bulls] of Bashan have encircled Me.

entries.title: Psalms 22:13
segments: They gape at Me [with] their mouths, [Like] a raging and roaring lion.

entries.title: Psalms 22:14
segments: I am poured out like water, And all My bones are out of joint; My heart is like wax; It has melted within Me.

entries.title: Psalms 22:15
segments: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, And My tongue clings to My jaws; You have brought Me to the dust of death.

entries.title: Psalms 22:16
segments: For dogs have surrounded Me; The congregation of the wicked has enclosed Me. They pierced My hands and My feet;

entries.title: Psalms 22:17
segments: I can count all My bones. They look [and] stare at Me.

entries.title: Psalms 22:18
segments: They divide My garments among them, And for My clothing they cast lots.

entries.title: Psalms 22:19
segments: But You, O LORD, do not be far from Me; O My Strength, hasten to help Me!

entries.title: Psalms 22:20
segments: Deliver Me from the sword, My precious [life] from the power of the dog.

entries.title: Psalms 22:21
segments: Save Me from the lion's mouth And from the horns of the wild oxen! You have answered Me.

entries.title: Psalms 22:22
segments: ¶I will declare Your name to My brethren; In the midst of the assembly I will praise You.

entries.title: Psalms 22:23
segments: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify Him, And fear Him, all you offspring of Israel!

entries.title: Psalms 22:24
segments: For He has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Nor has He hidden His face from Him; But when He cried to Him, He heard.

entries.title: Psalms 22:25
segments: My praise [shall be] of You in the great assembly; I will pay My vows before those who fear Him.

entries.title: Psalms 22:26
segments: The poor shall eat and be satisfied; Those who seek Him will praise the LORD. Let your heart live forever!

entries.title: Psalms 22:27
segments: All the ends of the world Shall remember and turn to the LORD, And all the families of the nations Shall worship before You.

entries.title: Psalms 22:28
segments: For the kingdom [is] the LORD'S, And He rules over the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 22:29
segments: All the prosperous of the earth Shall eat and worship; All those who go down to the dust Shall bow before Him, Even he who cannot keep himself alive.

entries.title: Psalms 22:30
segments: A posterity shall serve Him. It will be recounted of the Lord to the [next] generation,

entries.title: Psalms 22:31
segments: They will come and declare His righteousness to a people who will be born, That He has done [this].
